In [[3640 BBY]], a '''spaceport''' on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] was used by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Theron Shan]] during his escape from the forces of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Morbo]]. The spaceport possessed at least six [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]].
